purpose: Qualification registry for leakage-safe pregame player availability data; no source is authorized for historical probability modeling until explicitly marked qualified.
t120_rule: Historical status used for a game must be demonstrably known no later than the authoritative production T-120 boundary. Later corrections, final inactives learned inside the boundary, actual participation, and snaps are prohibited substitutes.

sources.name: nflverse weekly injuries
sources.historical_coverage_claim: 2009 onward in loader documentation, but the upstream injury source died after the 2024 season and nflverse currently has no 2025 injury data.
sources.stable_identity: historical rows can carry stable nflverse/GSIS-compatible player identity
sources.timestamp_semantics: weekly injury report fields; insufficient because target-season coverage is absent for 2025
sources.blocking_reason: zero qualifying 2025 injury rows in the current source stack; no complete 2022-2025 validation horizon
sources.permitted_use: 2022-2024 descriptive/research diagnostics only; not a complete historical availability feature for a 2022-2025 probability backtest

sources.name: NFL.com official weekly injury report pages
sources.historical_coverage_claim: Official 2025 weekly pages are publicly retrievable and expose player, position, injury, practice status, and game status.
sources.stable_identity: public rendered table does not expose the stable player identifier required by the current research contract
sources.timestamp_semantics: the rendered historical page does not expose a per-record publication/update timestamp or historical revision sequence
sources.blocking_reason: cannot prove from the rendered page alone exactly which row state was present at T-120 or safely crosswalk every player by stable ID
sources.permitted_use: prospective manual/reference validation when captured before T-120; not currently authorized as a retrospective 2022-2025 modeling source

sources.name: Sportradar NFL API v7 Weekly Injuries
sources.historical_coverage_claim: Sportradar documents historical Weekly Injuries retrieval by season/week and broader NFL historical API coverage; post-2020 data are collected by Sportradar operators.
sources.stable_identity: player GUID plus Sportsradar player ID where available
sources.timestamp_semantics: Weekly Injuries exposes injury status_date; Daily Change Log exposes entity-change timestamps and remains queryable for historical dates.
sources.blocking_reason: documentation is promising but a current historical response may reflect later corrections; LevLine must verify whether status_date/change-log history is sufficient to reconstruct the exact state known by T-120 and must validate ID crosswalk coverage before use
required_audit: validate all status_date values against kickoff/T-120
audit Daily Change Log around representative report revisions
confirm whether later corrections overwrite or can be reconstructed
build deterministic Sportradar-to-GSIS crosswalk and report missing/ambiguous rate
compare representative rows against archived official NFL reports
sources.permitted_use: research source qualification only until audit passes

sources.name: SportsDataIO NFL injuries
sources.historical_coverage_claim: NFL injury objects expose status/body part and an Updated datetime; product-level historical endpoint/access semantics require subscription verification.
sources.stable_identity: provider PlayerID/TeamID; deterministic crosswalk to GSIS would still be required
sources.timestamp_semantics: Updated is documented as the injury-status update time in US Eastern time; DeclaredInactive is updated near game time and is only populated for offensive skill positions.
sources.blocking_reason: public documentation does not by itself establish complete 2022-2025 point-in-time revision history or stable-ID crosswalk quality for LevLine
sources.permitted_use: research source qualification only until historical/revision audit passes
